verdict.rationale: Chroma publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec: a probe returned HTTP 200 at docs.trychroma.com/openapi.json containing an "openapi" key. Its docs also describe programmatic `.get` and `.query` operations with filtering, so the product can be driven through a documented public API. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of real-world API usage, and evidence in the pack of the endpoint reference details (such as auth and request/response schemas) beyond the spec's existence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
